items.title: Tapering and Peaking in the Weight Lifting Sports: A Systematic Review of Athletes’ Self-Reported Strategies
items.summary: A systematic review compiles self-reported strategies used by athletes for tapering and peaking in weightlifting sports, highlighting common practices.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述总结了举重运动员在赛前减量和巅峰期的策略。你可以参考这些常见的自我报告实践，为你的举重运动员提供更个性化、更有效的赛前训练调整指导，帮助他们达到最佳竞技状态。
items.titleZh: 举重运动员赛前减量和巅峰期策略的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述收集了举重运动员在赛前减量和巅峰期策略方面的自我报告数据，强调了常见做法。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review compiles self-reported strategies for tapering and peaking in weightlifting sports. You can use these common practices to offer more personalized and effective pre-competition training adjustments for your weightlifters, helping them achieve peak performance.
items.limitation: 证据来源于运动员的自我报告策略，可能存在回忆偏差和主观性，并非基于客观生理测量。
items.limitationEn: Evidence is based on athletes' self-reported strategies, which may be subject to recall bias and subjectivity, and not based on objective physiological measurements.

items.title: Rehabilitative game-based exercise integrated into conservative treatment for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis: a pilot randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A pilot randomized controlled trial explores the integration of rehabilitative game-based exercise into conservative treatment for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis (AIS), aiming to increase patient engagement.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步的 RCT 提示，游戏化运动可能提升青少年特发性脊柱侧弯（AIS）患者的依从性。尽管是小样本，你可以在临床中考虑将游戏元素融入治疗方案，以提高年轻患者的参与度和积极性。
items.titleZh: 游戏化运动与保守治疗结合改善青少年特发性脊柱侧弯：一项初步随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项初步随机对照试验探讨了将游戏化康复运动整合到青少年特发性脊柱侧弯（AIS）保守治疗中的潜力，旨在提高患者依从性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT suggests that game-based exercise may improve adherence in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis (AIS) patients. Even with a small sample, consider incorporating game elements into your treatment plans to boost engagement and motivation in younger patients.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步随机对照试验，未提供具体依从性或疗效数据，且样本量有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a pilot randomized controlled trial without specific adherence or efficacy data, and with a limited sample size.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effect of a multidisciplinary intensive outpatient rehabilitation program on plasma neurofilaments and myokines in Parkinson’s disease: an exploratory analysis
items.summary: An exploratory analysis investigates the effect of a multidisciplinary intensive outpatient rehabilitation program on plasma neurofilaments and myokines in Parkinson's disease, exploring underlying biological mechanisms.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性分析提示，针对帕金森病患者的多学科强化门诊康复可能通过调节血浆神经丝和肌因子来产生生物学效应。这为运动在神经退行性疾病中的作用提供了新的生物标志物研究方向，但尚不能直接指导临床方案调整。
items.titleZh: 多学科强化门诊康复对帕金森病患者血浆神经丝和肌因子的影响：一项探索性分析
items.summaryZh: 一项探索性分析研究了帕金森病患者多学科强化门诊康复计划对血浆神经丝和肌因子的影响，旨在阐明其潜在的生物学机制。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory analysis suggests that a multidisciplinary intensive outpatient rehabilitation program for Parkinson's disease might exert biological effects by modulating plasma neurofilaments and myokines. This opens new biomarker research avenues for exercise in neurodegenerative diseases but does not yet directly inform clinical protocol adjustments.
items.limitation: 这是一项探索性分析，其结果需要更大型的随机对照试验来验证。
items.limitationEn: This is an exploratory analysis, and its results require validation in larger randomized controlled trials.

items.title: Exploring Factors to Explain Interindividual Responses to Running Economy in Advanced Footwear Technology Shoes: A Randomised Crossover Laboratory Trial with an Explanatory Predictor Analysis
items.summary: A randomized crossover laboratory trial investigates factors explaining interindividual responses to running economy in advanced footwear technology shoes, with an explanatory predictor analysis.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 揭示了高性能跑鞋对跑步经济性的个体反应差异。在为运动员提供跑鞋建议时，请记住这种差异，不要盲目推荐，而应结合个体评估和反馈。
items.titleZh: 高性能跑鞋对跑步经济性的个体反应差异及其解释因素：一项随机交叉实验室试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机交叉实验室试验，通过解释性预测因子分析，探索了高性能跑鞋在提高跑步经济性方面个体反应差异的因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT highlights individual differences in running economy responses to advanced footwear. When advising athletes on shoes, remember this variability; avoid blanket recommendations and instead integrate individual assessments and feedback.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小，且是在实验室环境下进行，其结果在实际跑动场景中的普适性有待验证。
items.limitationEn: The study's sample size is relatively small, and it was conducted in a laboratory setting, so the generalizability of its findings to real-world running scenarios needs further validation.

items.title: Assessing concerns about falling: a comparison of telephone-based and face-to-face FES-I interviews in older adults
items.summary: A study comparing telephone-based and face-to-face interviews for assessing concerns about falling (FES-I) in older adults found comparable results, supporting remote assessment methods.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究发现，电话访谈和面对面访谈在评估老年人跌倒担忧（FES-I）方面效果相当。这意味着你在远程医疗中可以放心地使用电话访谈，这为老年患者的跌倒风险评估提供了便利且有效的途径。
items.titleZh: 电话与面对面访谈评估老年人跌倒担忧的比较研究
items.summaryZh: 一项比较电话和面对面访谈评估老年人跌倒担忧（FES-I）的研究发现结果具有可比性，支持远程评估方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found that telephone and face-to-face interviews are comparable for assessing concerns about falling (FES-I) in older adults. This means you can confidently use telephone interviews in telehealth, providing a convenient and effective way to assess fall risk for elderly patients.
items.limitation: 研究未明确提供参与者的基线特征和具体评估工具的信效度数据，可能影响结果的泛化性。
items.limitationEn: The study does not explicitly provide baseline characteristics of participants or specific reliability and validity data for the assessment tools, which may affect the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Effects of high-definition transcranial direct current stimulation on muscle strength, proprioception, cutaneous sensitivity and their relationship with balance in older adults with a history of falls
items.summary: This study investigates the effects of high-definition transcranial direct current stimulation (HD-tDCS) on muscle strength, proprioception, cutaneous sensitivity, and balance in older adults with a history of falls.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究表明，高清经颅直流电刺激（HD-tDCS）可能对有跌倒史老年人的肌肉力量、本体感觉、皮肤敏感度及平衡产生积极影响。你可以将其视为一种潜在的辅助干预手段，但目前尚不足以作为常规推荐，仍需更高级别的证据支持。
items.titleZh: 高清经颅直流电刺激对有跌倒史老年人肌肉力量、本体感觉、皮肤敏感度及其与平衡关系的影响
items.summaryZh: 本研究旨在调查高清经颅直流电刺激（HD-tDCS）对有跌倒史老年人的肌肉力量、本体感觉、皮肤敏感度及其与平衡能力之间关系的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study indicates that High-Definition Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation (HD-tDCS) may positively affect muscle strength, proprioception, cutaneous sensitivity, and balance in older adults with a history of falls. You can consider it a potential adjunctive intervention, but it's not yet ready for routine recommendation; higher-level evidence is needed.
items.limitation: 研究设计未明确说明，且结论来自对多项生理指标的探索性分析，需要更明确的对照试验验证。
items.limitationEn: The study design is not clearly specified, and conclusions are derived from an exploratory analysis of multiple physiological parameters, requiring more definitive controlled trials for validation.

items.title: Unstable-surface squats are associated with lower postural stability indices but not interlimb sway asymmetry in healthy young adults
items.summary: Unstable-surface squats are associated with lower postural stability indices but not interlimb sway asymmetry in healthy young adults, according to a recent study.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，不稳平面深蹲与较低的姿势稳定性指数相关，但在健康年轻人中未发现肢间晃动不对称。这意味着在训练中引入不稳平面可能有效挑战姿势控制，但对不对称性的影响仍需进一步研究。
items.titleZh: 不稳平面深蹲与健康年轻人姿势稳定性下降相关，但与肢间晃动不对称无关
items.summaryZh: 一项最新研究显示，不稳平面深蹲与健康年轻人的姿势稳定性指数下降有关，但与肢间晃动不对称性无关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that unstable-surface squats are associated with lower postural stability indices but not interlimb sway asymmetry in healthy young adults. This suggests that introducing unstable surfaces in training may effectively challenge postural control, but its impact on asymmetry requires further investigation.
items.limitation: 研究仅评估了急性反应，长期训练效果和机制需要更多纵向研究。
items.limitationEn: The study only assessed acute responses, and the long-term training effects and mechanisms require more longitudinal research.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: The relationship between the uric acid to prealbumin ratio and frailty, muscle strength, and malnutrition risk in older geriatric outpatients: a retrospective cross-sectional study
items.summary: A retrospective cross-sectional study finds a relationship between the uric acid to prealbumin ratio and frailty, muscle strength, and malnutrition risk in older geriatric outpatients.
items.curatedReason: 这项回顾性观察研究提示，尿酸与前白蛋白比值可能与老年门诊患者的衰弱、肌肉力量和营养不良风险相关。你可以考虑在临床筛查中关注这一比值，作为早期识别高风险老年患者的潜在生物标志物。
items.titleZh: 尿酸与前白蛋白比值与老年门诊患者衰弱、肌肉力量和营养不良风险的关系：一项回顾性横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性横断面研究发现，尿酸与前白蛋白比值与老年门诊患者的衰弱、肌肉力量和营养不良风险之间存在关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective observational study suggests that the uric acid to prealbumin ratio may be linked to frailty, muscle strength, and malnutrition risk in older geriatric outpatients. You could consider monitoring this ratio in clinical screening as a potential biomarker for early identification of high-risk elderly patients.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且结果可能受限于特定门诊人群。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective cross-sectional study, so it cannot establish causality, and the results may be limited to a specific outpatient population.

items.title: Opioids Do Not Relieve Persistent  Breathlessness among COPD patients,  suggests study
items.summary: A study suggests that opioids do not relieve persistent breathlessness among COPD patients, highlighting the need for alternative interventions.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，阿片类药物并不能有效缓解COPD患者的持续性呼吸困难。这提醒你在处理COPD患者呼吸困难时，需要优先考虑非药物干预措施，并将阿片类药物作为辅助或末线选择。
items.titleZh: 研究提示阿片类药物无法缓解 COPD 患者持续性呼吸困难
items.summaryZh: 一项研究表明，阿片类药物无法缓解COPD患者的持续性呼吸困难，强调了替代干预措施的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that opioids do not effectively relieve persistent breathlessness in COPD patients. This reminds you to prioritize non-pharmacological interventions when managing breathlessness in COPD patients and consider opioids as an adjunct or last-line option.
items.limitation: 新闻报道未提供原始研究的具体设计和数据，因此无法评估其证据强度和细节。
items.limitationEn: The news report does not provide specific study design and data from the original research, so its evidence strength and details cannot be assessed.

items.title: Mepivacaine Provides Greater Short-Term Relief Than Dry Needling and Local Lidocaine for Myofascial Pain: Study
items.summary: A study comparing mepivacaine, dry needling, and local lidocaine for myofascial pain found that mepivacaine provided greater short-term relief.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究发现，甲哌卡因在短期内比干针和利多卡因更能缓解肌筋膜疼痛。在治疗肌筋膜疼痛时，你可以将此信息纳入决策，尤其是在患者对短期快速缓解有需求时。
items.titleZh: 研究：甲哌卡因在短期内缓解肌筋膜疼痛优于干针和利多卡因
items.summaryZh: 一项比较甲哌卡因、干针和局部利多卡因治疗肌筋膜疼痛的研究发现，甲哌卡因在短期内提供了更显著的缓解。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found that mepivacaine provides greater short-term relief than dry needling and local lidocaine for myofascial pain. You can incorporate this information into your decision-making when treating myofascial pain, especially when patients require quick short-term relief.
items.limitation: 新闻报道未提供原始研究的具体设计和数据，因此无法评估其证据强度和细节，且仅关注短期效果。
items.limitationEn: The news report does not provide specific study design and data from the original research, so its evidence strength and details cannot be assessed, and it only focuses on short-term effects.

items.title: Machine learning analysis of demographic, rehabilitation, and performance factors associated with Olympic medal productivity in elite athletes
items.summary: A machine learning analysis explores demographic, rehabilitation, and performance factors associated with Olympic medal productivity in elite athletes.
items.curatedReason: 这项机器学习分析提供了关于精英运动员人口学、康复和表现因素与奥运奖牌产出之间关联的洞察。你可以利用这些数据驱动的发现，更精准地评估运动员的潜力，并优化他们的训练和康复策略。
items.titleZh: 机器学习分析精英运动员人口学、康复和表现因素与奥运奖牌产出关联性
items.summaryZh: 一项机器学习分析探讨了精英运动员的人口统计学、康复和表现因素与奥运奖牌产出之间的关联性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study uses machine learning to analyze the association between demographic, rehabilitation, and performance factors and Olympic medal productivity in elite athletes. This offers data-driven insights for sports rehabilitation and training strategies, helping you identify key variables that may influence athlete success.
items.limitation: 机器学习模型的结果依赖于输入数据的质量和代表性，可能存在过拟合或未能捕捉到所有复杂交互。
items.limitationEn: The results of machine learning models depend on the quality and representativeness of the input data, and may be subject to overfitting or failure to capture all complex interactions.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Positional Therapy May Ease COPD Breathlessness, suggests research
items.summary: Research suggests that positional therapy may ease breathlessness in COPD patients, offering a non-pharmacological approach to symptom management.
items.curatedReason: 研究提示体位疗法可能有助于缓解 COPD 患者的呼吸困难。这是一个简单、非药物的辅助干预选择，你可以在临床实践中指导患者尝试，以改善他们的呼吸不适。
items.titleZh: 研究提示体位疗法可缓解 COPD 患者呼吸困难
items.summaryZh: 研究表明，体位疗法可能有助于缓解慢性阻塞性肺病（COPD）患者的呼吸困难，提供了一种非药物的症状管理方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: Research suggests that positional therapy may ease breathlessness in COPD patients. This is a simple, non-pharmacological adjunctive intervention option you can guide patients to try in clinical practice to help manage their respiratory discomfort.
items.limitation: 新闻报道未提供原始研究的具体设计和数据，因此无法评估其证据强度和细节。
items.limitationEn: The news report does not provide specific study design and data from the original research, so its evidence strength and details cannot be assessed.

items.title: Neurology | American Board of Physical Therapy Education Residency and Fellowship
items.summary: The American Board of Physical Therapy Residency and Fellowship Education (ABPTRFE) has released a Description of Residency Practice (DRP) for Neurology, aiming to standardize curriculum and streamline accreditation for residency programs.
items.curatedReason: APTA 旗下 ABPTRFE 发布了神经学专业住院医师实践描述 (DRP)，旨在统一神经康复住院医师的培训标准。如果你所在的机构有神经康复住院医师项目，这可以作为课程设计和认证的参考。
items.titleZh: 美国物理治疗教育委员会发布神经学住院医师实践描述
items.summaryZh: 美国物理治疗住院医师与专科培训教育委员会（ABPTRFE）发布了神经学住院医师实践描述（DRP），旨在规范课程并简化住院医师项目的认证流程。
items.curatedReasonEn: ABPTRFE under APTA has released the Description of Residency Practice (DRP) for neurology, aiming to standardize training for neurological rehabilitation residents. If your institution has a neurological rehabilitation residency program, this can serve as a reference for curriculum design and accreditation.

items.title: Clean Claims To-Do List for Rehab Therapy Billing Teams
items.summary: WebPT has published a "Clean Claims To-Do List" to guide rehab therapy billing teams in managing and monitoring daily tasks to ensure accurate and error-free claims.
items.curatedReason: WebPT 的这份“清洁索赔待办事项清单”对于康复治疗计费团队来说非常实用。你可以借鉴这份清单来规范你的诊所流程，以确保计费准确无误，从而减少拒付并提高运营效率。
items.titleZh: 康复治疗计费团队的“清洁索赔待办事项清单”
items.summaryZh: WebPT 发布了一份“清洁索赔待办事项清单”，旨在指导康复治疗计费团队管理和监控日常任务，以确保索赔准确无误。
items.curatedReasonEn: WebPT's 'Clean Claims To-Do List' is highly practical for rehabilitation therapy billing teams. You can use this list to standardize your clinic's processes, ensuring accurate billing to reduce denials and improve operational efficiency.

items.title: A grade-specific clinical prediction rule for independent walking after traumatic spinal cord injury.
items.summary: A clinical prediction rule was developed using the National Spinal Cord Injury Statistical Centre dataset (2607 patients) to predict independent walking one year after traumatic SCI, identifying grade-specific predictors.
items.curatedReason: 这个基于大样本数据集开发的临床预测规则，能根据 ASIA 损伤分级为创伤性脊髓损伤患者提供一年后独立步行的差异化预后，对于制定康复计划和管理患者期望很有价值。
items.titleZh: 创伤性脊髓损伤后独立行走的等级特异性临床预测规则
items.summaryZh: 一项研究利用全国脊髓损伤统计中心数据集（2607 名患者）开发了一个临床预测规则，旨在预测创伤性脊髓损伤患者一年后的独立行走能力，并识别了与损伤等级相关的预测因子。
items.curatedReasonEn: This clinical prediction rule, developed using a large dataset, provides differentiated prognosis for independent walking one year after traumatic spinal cord injury based on ASIA Impairment Scale grades, valuable for rehabilitation planning and managing patient expectations.
items.limitation: 预测变量的选择和机器学习模型建立的细节需进一步公开，以评估其稳健性和可解释性。
items.limitationEn: Further details on the selection of predictive variables and the establishment of machine learning models are needed to assess robustness and interpretability.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation
